title: 3 Dangerous Rain Driving Mistakes (Part 2)
hook: Part 2! Never drive through standing water.

script.narration: Part 2! Never drive through standing water.
script.visual_search: car driving fast through large puddle water splash

script.narration: Hitting deep puddles at speed causes hydroplaning, where a thin layer of water lifts your tires completely off the road.
script.visual_search: tires splashing through heavy rain on highway

script.narration: If you start to hydroplane, ease off the gas and keep the steering wheel pointed straight.
script.visual_search: driver holding steering wheel straight in rain

script.narration: Like if this helped, follow for daily driving tips. Have you hydroplaned before? Comment yes or no, because you should...
script.visual_search: rain drops falling on car windshield driving

description: Part 2 of our Rain Driving Safety series! Learn how to handle standing water puddles and avoid dangerous hydroplaning on wet roads.
